description: This PHP class 'FormatWithActivity' implements a formatting strategy for entity values, specifically retrieving the name of a 'ProjectActivity' based on an ID. It uses traits for timesheet service functionalities and implements an interface for value formatting within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: FormatWithActivity
classes.description: A class that formats a value to the name of a ProjectActivity retrieved via a timesheet service, given an activity ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of a ProjectActivity corresponding to the given entity value (ID), or null if not found or not an instance of ProjectActivity.
